buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. SITC OF ONLINE CONTINUOUS EFFLUENT MONITORING SYSTEM (OCEMS) Parameters: COD, BOD, pH, TDS & TSS Equipment Type: Online Effluent Water Quality Monitoring System Monitoring Method: CPCB-approved method based on UV-Vis Spectrophotometry, wherever applicable. A. Vetted Technical Specifications 1. Sample Intake Flow Rate: 2–5 L/min. 2. Measurement Technology: UV-Vis Spectrophotometer with microcontroller-based electronic circuit and full-spectrum scanning facility. 3. Output & Connectivity: RS485 communication interface for real-time online data transmission to CPCB/MPPCB servers, as per applicable regulatory requirements. B. Monitoring Parameters and Measuring Ranges Parameter Measuring Range COD 0–1000 mg/L (higher range, if required) BOD 0–1000 mg/L (higher range, if required) TSS 0–1000 mg/L (higher range, if required) pH 0–14 pH TDS 0–100,000 PPM

TDS Accuracy ±10% C. Electrical and System Specifications 1. Power Supply: 220–240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 40 VA; universal input 90–264 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 40 VA. 2. Display: 16 × 2 character display. 3. Circuit Protection: Microcontroller-based control circuit with integrated surge protection. 4. Temperature Compensation: Automatic microcontroller-based temperature compensation from 0°C to 100°C, wherever applicable to the respective sensors/probes. 1. Sample Intake Flow Rate: The sample intake flow rate shall be clearly specified in the tender document. A flow rate of 2–5 L/min is considered adequate for the proposed effluent flow of approximately 10 m³/day, subject to actual site conditions and equipment requirements. 2. CPCB/MPPCB Connectivity: The system shall comply with the applicable CPCB and MPPCB guidelines for continuous online effluent monitoring. The communication interface and data transmission arrangement shall ensure reliable and uninterrupted transmission of monitoring data to the designated regulatory servers. 3. Temperature Compensation and Calibration: All applicable analytical probes/sensors shall be provided with automatic temperature compensation. The contractor shall provide standard calibration solutions and carry out calibration of all sensors/probes during installation and commissioning. 4. Enclosure and Surge Protection: All control units, power supply circuits, display units and associated electrical components shall be housed in suitable weatherproof, corrosion-resistant industrial enclosures. Adequate surge protection shall be provided for the complete system. 5. Mandatory Site Inspection: The prospective bidders shall inspect the site at GOAW, Neemuch, before submission of their bids to assess actual site conditions, sample collection points, sample line routing, effluent discharge channels and the associated installation requirements. 6. Drawings, Certificates and Approval: The successful bidder/contractor shall submit the following documents to the Production Manager, GOAW, Neemuch, for examination and approval before commencement of supply and installation: � General Arrangement (GA) drawings and installation layout. � Applicable CPCB approval/recognition documents. � OEM technical specifications and test certificates. � Details of communication interface and online data transmission arrangements.

7. Civil and Electrical Works: All civil and electrical works required for complete installation, testing and commissioning of the Online Continuous Effluent Monitoring System (OCEMS), including associated cabling, wiring, electrical connections, foundations/support structures, sample collection arrangements and other incidental works, shall be entirely within the scope of the contractor. The cost of all such works shall be deemed to be included in the quoted rates. No extra payment shall be admissible on this account. Documents to be requested from participating bidders I recommend including the following requirements in the technical bid: 1. GST Registration Certificate. 2. Firm registration certificate / incorporation certificate. 3. Technical compliance statement against each specification. 4. OEM authorization certificate, wherever applicable. 5. OEM product datasheet and technical literature. 6. Documentary evidence of applicable CPCB approval/recognition and compliance with MPPCB requirements. 7. Details of previous similar OCEMS supply and installation work, supported by purchase orders and satisfactory completion certificates. 8. Details of service support and availability of trained technical personnel. 9. Warranty undertaking. 10. Undertaking for site inspection and acceptance of complete civil and electrical work responsibility. 11. Declaration regarding acceptance of GeM GTC and buyer's ATC. 12. ISO Certification: The bidder must possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 certification. 13. Similar Work Experience: The bidder must have successfully executed at least 2–3 similar nature of works/supplies during the last three years. Documentary evidence, such as work orders and completion certificates, must be submitted. 14. Annual Turnover: The bidder must have an average annual turnover of ₹1 crore to ₹2 crore during the last three financial years. Audited financial statements or CA-certified turnover bidder must be submit scan copy of following document 1. Sacn copy of curent and valid GST registreation 2. The bidder shall submit a copy of the Scope of Work/Details of Work (02 pages), duly signed and stampe d on each page, as attached in the ATC document, as a token of acceptance of all the terms and condition s. The bidder shall also submit all certificates and supporting documents as required under the bid. .
